data.subject: Public-record research for Gate City
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in AXR and ALCO.

AXR reported Q2 2026 revenue of $6.1M versus $17.9M a year earlier, down 66.1% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6207/000110465926107084/0001104659-26-107084-index.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, and filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue or set up a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
